findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a prior review is stale while the check for close's updated review is still pending.
The previously flagged test was deleted without an equivalent end-to-end proof. The replacement at tests/test_pr_check_base_older_than_merged_default.py:16-21 closes a fix with no prior review using the fixture's already-green check runs, then invokes pr-check separately. It never models the old failed commit status or the new head's pending and successful status, so a failure specific to refreshing an existing stale review can still pass the proof. The old-head test at tests/test_fix_close_pushes_its_review_commit_while_the.py:16-34 supplies check runs and expects close to stop; it does not show close reaching Ready after the new status succeeds without a rerun.
